name: payment-orchestrator
description: Multi-rail payment orchestrator and reconciliation engine (portfolio project)

scripts.setup: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && pnpm install && docker compose up -d --wait && pnpm --filter @po/api db:deploy && pnpm --filter @po/api db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,mock-a,mock-b,dash -c blue,magenta,yellow,cyan,green "pnpm --filter @po/api dev" "pnpm --filter @po/api dev:worker" "pnpm --filter @po/mock-gateway dev:a" "pnpm --filter @po/mock-gateway dev:b" "pnpm --filter @po/dashboard dev"
